product.title: The Narrows: Zion National Park Private Guided Hike

description.text: Hike the Narrows on a private guided outing that handles logistics, safety briefing, and pacing through Zion's most famous slot canyon. Your guide leads the Riverside Walk to the Virgin River entrance, then continues upstream through towering sandstone walls when conditions permit. Dry bags, walking sticks, and route selection are matched to seasonal flow levels. This private format keeps the focus on your group's comfort while maximizing time in the water-filled canyon.

highlights: Private guided Narrows hike in Zion National Park
Riverside Walk approach with gear briefing
Dry bags and walking sticks provided
Route adjusted to seasonal Virgin River flow
Ideal for hikers seeking a dedicated Narrows day

start.description: Meet at the Zion Lodge area or Springdale pickup point confirmed at booking. Wear closed-toe water shoes.

end.description: Return to the Temple of Sinawava trailhead or your pickup location after the Narrows hike.
